behavior: Expose commit-pinned Graphify index evaluation and edge policy from @structile/agent-harness so stale, unverifiable or inferred-only context can never be treated as evidence.
nonGoals: No Graphify index construction, extraction or indexing service
No network access and no Graphify API client
No changes to the adapter, transport or evidence code paths
No planning, requirement or catalog edits
notes: First micro-task under the delivery operating model section 8 step 7: a thin, already-specified G1 behavior chosen to prove the contract/task-ready/verifier loop end to end. The protected HAR-004 suite (structile-conformance#19, merged) already asserts the exact surface: exports evaluateGraphifyIndex, assertEdgeUsable, GRAPHIFY_EXTRACTOR_VERSION and GraphifyPolicyError; a current index is usable context and never evidence; commit, repository and extractor-version mismatches are ignored with a recorded reason, and an absent, malformed, wrong-algorithm or empty content hash is ignored too (there the suite asserts only usable=false and does not require a reason); a missing index degrades to unusable; INFERRED or malformed edges are refused with GraphifyPolicyError while RESOLVED edges with a source reference are accepted. re-pinned 2026-09-09, the second re-pin: this contract was opened on 2026-08-25 against core main 10f48a07 and was left behind when 1cfd325 re-pinned the five merged HAR durability contracts, so both of its oracle pins had gone stale while the pull request sat open. baseCommit is core main c8ca6922e1b5ac6c873e5484f3fc914eadf4d8ab. testSourceDigest is the oracle-input digest of structile-conformance main 20ca0d302c7747417336836b37aefb7e99e3b77d, recomputed independently by replicating evidence.ts runnerDigests over its isOracleInput set (src/**, fixtures/**, verification/test-catalog.json, verification/evidence.schema.json; 26 files); it now genuinely matches the value the five merged HAR durability contracts carry, which the previous note claimed while carrying the superseded 215ff9da digest. Separately, runnerDigest carries the attested G0 runner image digest because no G1 runner digest exists yet: the protected G1 workflow builds the image fresh from Containerfile and computes imageDigest from the built image, and conformance src/ and verification/ have grown substantially since the G0 authority commit, so the G1 image's digest will differ. task-ready v1 verifies neither digest, but readiness against a real protected run requires the pinned runner to match, so this field is a placeholder to be re-pinned to the first attested G1 runner digest. Every task contract merged to date carries the same placeholder.
